direction_notes.sampoq: Supplier -> Customer (derived from filing relationship type)
direction_notes.anonnet: As provided (source -> target); direction not formally documented

label_availability.shipment_delay: available for 156,488 shipments (SynDelay synthetic 3-class, Smart Logistics binary)

known_limitations: Company identities are not cross-source resolved; IC-SPLC and AnonNet entities are anonymised.
No verified company-level risk labels exist in the acquired sources.
AnonNet direction is not formally documented.
SynDelay label semantics are undocumented; do not interpret classes as delay severity.
Restricted CC BY-NC disruption monitoring data is excluded from this graph and from training.
GDELT records are unverified news mentions, not confirmed disruptions.

license_notes.disruption_monitoring: CC BY-NC 4.0; excluded from main graph
license_notes.gdelt: GDELT public data; check GDELT terms
